Hewitt Westchester LP

Longwood, Bronx

Built in 2010 | 83 units
2-bedroom unit (1 available)

Hewitt Westchester Avenue LP is a re-rental multifamily project consisting of 83 units located at 886 Westchester Avenue between Hewitt Place and Rev James A Polite Ave in the Bronx, New York. The Project consists of 13 studios, 27 one-bedrooms, 42 two-bedrooms and one superintendents unit. The development also features approximately 13,000 s/f of ground floor commercial space.
